titel: Paper thin model? Give it real walls in Blender 🏺 #blender #3dprinting
printzin: Every printer is different: print a small test first.

scenes.tekst: Is your model just one paper thin surface?
scenes.label: QUICK CHECK

scenes.tekst: A wall with zero thickness has nothing to print.
scenes.label: PROBLEM

scenes.tekst: No need to model a second wall by hand. One modifier does it.
scenes.label: TIP

scenes.tekst: Open the Modifier properties and click Add Modifier.
scenes.label: STEP 1

scenes.tekst: Click the Thickness field, type 2 and press Enter.
scenes.label: STEP 3
scenes.uitspraak: Click the Thickness field, type two, and press Enter.

scenes.tekst: Now the edge is a real wall, 2 mm thick, all the way around.
scenes.label: SOLID
scenes.uitspraak: Now the edge is a real wall, two millimeters thick, all the way around.

scenes.tekst: Offset minus 1 puts the wall on the inside, so the outside keeps its size.
scenes.label: BONUS
scenes.uitspraak: Offset minus one puts the wall on the inside, so the outside keeps its size.

scenes.tekst: And Even Thickness keeps the wall the same on sharp corners.
scenes.label: BONUS

scenes.tekst: Every printer is different, so print a small test first. Save this for your next print.
scenes.label: PRINT FIRST

scenes.tekst: Make your prints poseable: Click Joints Pro, on Gumroad.
scenes.label: CLICK JOINTS PRO
scenes.uitspraak: Make your prints poseable: Click Joints Pro, on Gumroad.
